statement: A sequence is defined by $u_1=1$ and $u_{n+1}=2u_n+1$ for $n\ge1$. Find a closed form for $u_n$.
solution:
Rewrite the recurrence as $u_{n+1}+1=2(u_n+1)$. Hence the sequence $v_n=u_n+1$ satisfies $v_{n+1}=2v_n$, so it is geometric with ratio $2$. Since $v_1=u_1+1=2$, we have $v_n=2\cdot2^{n-1}=2^n$. Therefore
$$u_n=v_n-1=2^n-1.$$
